To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the MAC layer is a critical component of EH WSNs; the energy harvesting system and the MAC protocol are strongly related; and that the MAC layer should be designed to maximize the tradeoff between energy efficiency and network performance, while considering the specificities of the EH system and the application requirements.
the design of MAC protocols for EH-WSNs is a challenging task because it requires a careful balance between the energy spent by the MAC layer and the energy brought by the EH technology.
energy harvesting is an effective technique to extend WSNs lifetime, and that the interplay with MAC protocols is critical for a successful deployment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of MAC protocols for EH-WSN and their integration in the context of the Internet of Things (IoT).
the development of a new MAC protocol for EH WSN.
the design of MAC protocols for EH-WSNs and with the analysis of the interplay between the MAC protocol and the EH technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, despite the great effort spent on the subject, the design of a MAC protocol for EH WSN remains an open problem.
the energy harvested by a mote can be used to improve the network lifetime and/or increase the network throughput.

(i) the design of the EH MAC protocol is a challenging task because it must cope with the unpredictable nature of the harvested energy and the energy consumption of the MAC layer; (ii) the design of an EH MAC protocol is not a simple extension of a traditional one; (iii) the design of a good EH MAC protocol is an iterative process that requires to consider all the layers of the protocol stack; (iv) the design of good EH MAC protocols is still an open research issue.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this paper presents an extensive review of MAC protocols for EH-WSNs.
the MAC layer is a critical element in the design of EH WSNs and it should be carefully designed in order to maximize the energy efficiency.

we provide a detailed analysis on energy harvesting systems for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), and we illustrate a review on key Medium Access Control (MAC) protocols for Energy Harvesting WSNs with special focus on: fundamentals techniques, evaluation approaches and key performance indicators.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of MAC protocols for EH-WSNs is not straightforward and it requires to carefully balance the tradeoff among energy efficiency, latency, and throughput.
, while a number of MAC protocols for EHWSNs have been designed, there is no single solution that can be considered optimal in all the possible application scenarios.
, while the design of the EH subsystem is a critical issue in EH WSN, the design of the protocol stack is even more challenging.
